**Finding: Compliant** — § 4.4 "Audit Rights" (p0059).

The sole audit right binding our client meets the preferred position on all material terms:

| Term | Playbook preferred | § 4.4 |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | ≤ once / 12 months | "no more than once each calendar year" ✓ |
| Timing | business hours | "at reasonable times" ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | "upon reasonable notice" — unquantified (minor) |
| Auditor | independent, confidentiality-bound | independent CPA "reasonably acceptable to Corio" ✓ (Corio holds a veto) |
| Cost | Vendor's cost unless underpayment > 5% | Commerce One bears all costs; reimbursement only if underpayment > 5% ✓ |
| System access | none | records-only; no access language ✓ |

No other inspection/verification right exists (Exhibit B payment terms and Miscellaneous contain none), so no redline was proposed. The only gap — notice stated as "reasonable" rather than a fixed 30/15 days — is a minor sub-element noted in the rationale, not a deviation.
